title: baseURL uses https while the local server speaks http
summary: playwright.config.ts points baseURL at https://127.0.0.1:3100 while the webServer still serves plain http on 127.0.0.1:3100, so every page.goto fails the TLS handshake before the app loads. This is an environment/config misconfiguration, not an app bug.
